B_handler.validates_before_mutation: PARTIAL. canExecute() checks rotation finiteness, per-line id non-emptiness, duplicate line ids and positive arc radius, returning {valid:false, reason:string}. C11 5.2 asks for a typed DomainError; the typed GridSchemaError is thrown only inside execute() when Grid.parse(seed) rejects. That throw is still BEFORE produceCommand, so no partial mutation is possible.
B_handler.mutates_only_via_immer_draft: YES. The single mutation is produceCommand<GridsState>(ctx.stores.grid, draft => { draft[grid.id] = grid; }). No store-singleton import in the file.
B_handler.geometry_deferred_to_FrameScheduler: N/A -- the handler builds no geometry, and no grid committer is registered anywhere (see D.renders_3d).
B_handler.emits_typed_domain_event: NO. The handler emits nothing; CommandEventBridge emits on its behalf. This is C11 11.1 HANDLER-RUNTIME-EVENTS, open for all 177 handlers.
B_handler.otel_span: YES -- withHandlerSpan(this.type + '.handler', { 'pryzm.command.type': this.type }, ...) wraps the entire execute body.
B_handler.must_not_evidence: The file imports only @pryzm/plugin-sdk, ../errors.js and ../store.js. No commandManager.execute, no cascading dispatch, no window.dispatchEvent, no DOM access, no requestAnimationFrame, no import from src/engine or src/ui, and affectedStores names exactly one family.
B_handler.id_pre_generated_in_tool: YES in the plugin tool -- plugins/grid/src/tool.ts:49 const id = createId('grid'), then :51 bus.executeCommand('grid.create', { id, levelId, lines }). The handler still falls back: const id = (cmd.id ?? createId('grid')). The fallback is harmless ONLY because no bridge guards on !ev.id -- there is no bridge.

reachable.proof: The only dispatcher of grid.create is plugins/grid/src/tool.ts:51 (GridPlacementTool.onPointerDown). GridPlacementTool is constructed at exactly ONE site: apps/editor/src/PluginRegistry.ts:1086, inside the body of runtime.tools.register('grid:tool', ...). 'grid:tool' is never activated -- grep -rnE "tools[?]?\.activate\(" over apps packages plugins src, excluding tests, returns ONE production call site: apps/editor/src/ui/ai/chatPlacementActivation.ts:379 tools.activate(entry.tool), whose entries come from ELEMENT_CREATION_MATRIX, which declares the tool id 'grid' (elementCreationMatrix.ts:825), not 'grid:tool'. And 'grid' resolves elsewhere: apps/editor/src/ui/layout/ToolsAreaLayout.ts registers runtime.tools.register('grid', () => { void tm.activateGrid?.(); }) -- the legacy ToolManager grid tool -- and states the distinction at :346, '(grid is safe: PluginRegistry binds grid:tool, a DIFFERENT id.)'. The AI route is closed too: packages/ai-host/src/capabilities/ChatCommandClassification.ts:64 puts grid.create in B_CREATION, blockedBy 'per-family placement grammar'.

renders_3d.proof: The 3D grid authority is packages/core-app-model/src/BimGridRenderer.ts, constructed at BimKernel.ts:151 and driven by BimManager, whose grid store is injected at apps/editor/src/engine/engineLauncher.ts:429 -- bimManager.setGridStore(gridStore) -- the LEGACY GridStore built at initBuilders.ts:1082 and assigned to window.gridStore at :1083. The plugin GridsState is a different object. The plugin committer is dead: grep -rn 'new GridCommitter' over apps packages plugins src -> no output (not even in plugins/grid/__tests__). Production code states the split explicitly at apps/editor/src/engine/views/canvasSubjectDelete.ts:33-36: 'grid -- grid.delete EXISTS (plugins/grid/src/handlers/DeleteGrid.ts) but writes the plain GridsState record, NOT the gridStore that the renderer and selectedGridInAnyPane() read.'

E_c11_cross_check.matrix_row: NO ROW. C11 11 (docs/02-decisions/contracts/C11-ELEMENT-CREATION-PIPELINE.md:1265-1294) carries 14 rows -- Wall, Slab, Curtain Wall, Ceiling, Roof, Column, Beam, Floor, Wall Opening, Stair, Handrail, Furniture, Lighting, Room. Grid is not one of them.
E_c11_cross_check.prose_claim: C11 11.11 (:1493-1501) audits Grid in prose: 'command-name split -- GridPlanToolHandler dispatches grid.add (routed by the initBusHandlers.ts:275 legacy bridge), while the grid plugin's own tool.ts dispatches grid.create (the PRYZM3 CreateGridHandler). Both paths are wired so grid creation is not broken.'
E_c11_cross_check.verdict: REFUTES on three counts. (1) 'Both paths are wired' is FALSE -- grid.create reaches no renderer, no plan projector, no serializer and no exporter, and its tool is never constructed because runtime.tools.activate('grid:tool') has zero call sites. (2) The cited bridge line is WRONG: grep -n "type: 'grid.add'" apps/editor/src/engine/initBusHandlers.ts -> 2383, not 275. (3) The missing matrix ROW is itself a DOC-CONFLICT: the matrix preamble calls itself 'the normative record' that 'MUST be updated whenever a bridge is added, removed, or repaired'.
